messages:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up — prepping the QBR slide pack for Northridge next Wed. Need final health summary, onboarding status, and top 3 renewal risks by EOD Friday. linking current deck: https://redwood.slides/northridge-qbr :calendar:
Marco (AM): On renewal risks — two signals: 1) usage dip in feature X (last 14 days), 2) delayed billing approvals. I'll attach short notes. Who can own the exec talking points for risk mitigation? :thinking_face:
Jin (Onboarding): Onboarding status: 78% of seats activated, 4 customers still in step "integration verification". Pulling last-run health dashboard now — will paste key metrics in a minute. :eyes:
Laura - Enablement: I can draft the exec 2-min talking points focused on adoption play and success stories. Also recommend a 10-min enablement demo section in the deck (slide 7).
Samir - Solutions: I can handle the demo fallback plan — which integrations to show if API access for the account is not provisioned. Will add a short script.
Marco (AM): Adding two bullet points for renewals: "billing blocker escalation path" and "targeted adoption sprint with CS Ops". Should we include an ask to Sales leadership for a decision window?
Aisha (CS): Yes — add an explicit ask: decision by COB Friday OR we flag as at-risk. Laura, can you add the ask copy? Jin, paste the 3 onboarding accounts that need engineering touch. Samir, demo fallback script by EOD Thurs please.
Jin (Onboarding): Paste from dashboard: 
- acct:northridge-pro — stuck on webhook certs (ticket #3321)
- acct:meridian-svc — missing env var mapping (ticket #3347)
- acct:harborline — delayed SAML test (ticket #3333)
Will escalate 3321 to infra today.
Laura - Enablement: Drafted ask copy: "Requesting Sales exec approval for billing remediation path and 1-week enablement sprint. Outcome requested: renewal commitment or formal risk flag." Pasting suggested slide note: `Slide 8 — Exec ask: Billing remediation + 1-week adoption sprint. Owner: Marco (AM)`
Samir - Solutions: Demo fallback plan (short): 
```
Primary demo: full-integrated flow using customer workspace
Fallback: orchestrated mock using sandbox + recorded clip of integration  (if API down)
Fallback owner: Samir
```
I also noted a quick troubleshooting checklist for the webhook certs — will DM Jin the steps.
cs-bot: Reminder: QBR checklist items pending: [health summary, onboarding exceptions, exec asks, demo script, action owner assignments]. Due Friday 17:00 PT. :bell:
Aisha (CS): Action summary for thread (I'll paste into Asana): 1) Marco — renewal ask + Sales exec ask copy (due Fri EOD) 2) Laura — enablement 2-min talking points + slide notes (due Thu) 3) Jin — escalate tickets and paste final onboarding status (due Thu) 4) Samir — demo fallback + checklist (due Thu EOD) 5) CS Ops — assemble final health slide and slack the deck for review (Aisha)
Marco (AM): Got it, will sync with Sales leadership and draft the decision window language.
Laura - Enablement: Dry-run scheduled Fri 9:30am PT; invite sent to Aisha + Marco + Samir. Please RSVP.
Jin (Onboarding): Escalation sent for ticket #3321. Will update dashboard and post the final numbers by Thursday noon.
Samir - Solutions: Demo script uploaded to the shared folder: https://redwood.docs/demos/northridge-fallback. I'll be on the dry-run.
Aisha (CS): Perfect. If no objections I'll lock the slide order tonight and send the deck for review tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Marco (AM): :thumbsup:
Laura - Enablement: :+1:
Jin (Onboarding): :eyes:
cs-bot: Task update: 3/5 outstanding items have owners. 2 remain open (health slide, Marco Sales ask).
Aisha (CS): Thanks all — let's keep this thread for any late edits. I'll push the draft by 09:00 tomorrow and tag reviewers.
